text:
josh_support: Hey team — customer reports ~1200 objects marked with the `archive` flag were removed earlier than their custom retention window. They hit us with a legal preservation request and need a timeline + whether we can pause deletes. Asking for urgent audit + hold.

carmen_sre: Account ID? sample object IDs?

josh_support: acct_8421, example object ids: obj_6642, obj_6643 (from their export). They say retention policy shows 90d but objects show tombstones after ~30d.

mike_eng: Noted. I will check deletion service logs and the policy propagation job for that account. Might be a policy override during a migration.

carmen_sre: Quick repro: run in admin: `GET /admin/objects?account=acct_8421&limit=50` and check `retention_policy` and `tombstone_ts` fields. Also grep the delete-worker logs for `acct_8421` between `2026-03-01` and `2026-03-10`.

mike_eng: Ran tail on delete-worker: found this entry: `2026-03-04T03:12:22Z delete-worker[pid=421]: delete-job executed account=acct_8421 object=obj_6642 policy=default ttl=2592000 tombstone=1709601142`. That ttl (2592000s = 30d) suggests the default retention was in effect at deletion time, not the custom 90d.

josh_support: Customer insists they set a custom policy on 2026-02-01. Is it possible the policy change never applied to existing objects?

mike_eng: Yes — current behavior: policy updates apply to new writes and some backfill paths require manual re-eval. I see a migration job that ran 2026-02-28 which may have reverted account-level policy to default temporarily.

tina_legal: We need a preservation action immediately. Can you place a legal hold and export current audit logs for the affected objects?

audit-bot: Legal hold request received. Created case LH-2026-0842. Preservation API: `POST /internal/preserve?account=acct_8421&case=LH-2026-0842` — will block deletions for matching objects.

mike_eng: I submitted the preserve call and it returned 202 Accepted. Confirmed hold flag set on obj_6642/obj_6643. Also kicked off a log export: `GET /admin/audit?account=acct_8421&from=2026-01-15&to=2026-03-15` — export job id audit-export-993.

carmen_sre: Next steps for root cause: 1) correlate policy-change events with migration logs (I have a pointer to the migration run 2026-02-28T02:00Z), 2) check IAM/KMS activity — if key rotation or KMS errors happened, deletes may have been retried incorrectly, 3) re-evaluate backfill behavior and schedule corrective re-apply of custom retention.

josh_support: Customer wants ETA for restored visibility & whether objects can be undeleted. Any chance for fast restore?

mike_eng: If tombstones were compacted and storage deleted, undelete is unlikely. But we can check object store tombstone retention window: `storage.tombstone_retention_days` is set to 7 for that region. If they are within that window, we can attempt restore from object-store replicas — ETA ~6-12h to validate. If beyond that, we'll only have audit logs and any offsite backups.

tina_legal: Keep me posted. We need the export for legal review and a written timeline for the customer.

audit-bot: Audit export job audit-export-993 is queued; estimated completion 45m.

carmen_sre: I'll open an internal incident and tag eng/runtime to review the migration job. Incident id: INC-2026-312. Assigning to @mike_eng and @josh_support.

josh_support: Thanks — I will communicate hold created and that we're investigating root cause; promise timeline and follow up once audit-export completes. :thumbsup:

mike_eng: I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft after we confirm whether objects are recoverable.

josh_support: Customer notified (told them: hold placed, audit export in progress, recovery verification underway). They asked for periodic updates every 2 hours.

carmen_sre: Logging commands used during triage (for runbook):
```
# check policy on account
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" "https://admin.internal/v1/accounts/acct_8421/policy"
# find delete events
grep acct_8421 /var/log/delete-worker/*.log | tail -n 50
# submit preserve
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL" \
  "https://internal.api/preserve?account=acct_8421&case=LH-2026-0842"
```

josh_support: Will update the thread when audit-export-993 completes or earlier if we get recoverability confirmation.

carmen_sre: Adding note: if we find migration job toggled policies, we should add a safety check to not backfill default for accounts with existing custom retention. Filing a follow-up task in backlog.

josh_support: Acknowledged.
